summary: NLP Cloud automatically grants a $15 free credit on the pay-as-you-go plan — per the site's own FAQ that plan requires a credit card, so the credit subsidizes a PAYG start rather than being a card-free grant. Separately, a $0 Free plan needs no card and covers pretrained models at 2 parallel requests with limited throughput, intended for development/testing. Pay-as-you-go has no fixed cost: CPU requests $0.003, GPU $0.005, plus per-token/second surcharges on generative models.
claim_steps: For the $15 credit: activate the pay-as-you-go plan — the site FAQ states a credit card is needed for this plan; the $15 credit applies automatically.
Card-free option: choose the $0 Free plan — pretrained models only, 2 parallel requests, limited throughput.

social_proof.title: Pricing | NLP Cloud
social_proof.text: Pay-As-You-Go — $0 / month + usage: No fixed cost: pay only if you consume; Automatically get a $15 FREE credit; All our pre-trained models are available; Parallel requests: 10 (can be increased). Free pre-paid plan: $0, 2 parallel requests.

social_proof.title: Advanced Artificial Intelligence API | NLP Cloud
social_proof.text: All the AI models can be tested for free thanks to the Free plan without a credit card, but the throughput on this plan is very limited. The pay-as-you-go plan is the best way to easily test all the features without restrictions. A credit card is needed for this plan, but you automatically get an initial $15 credit for your tests.
